AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: An app that can search photos with specific keywords. **Capabilities and APIs:** * **Search for photos**: Search for photos with specific keywords. Use `findPhotos` when the user wants to search for photos with specific keywords. e.g., 'Show me photos of my trip to Thailand.' The keyword is 'Thailand'. If there are any photos that match the keyword, it will return a photo list. Otherwise, it will return an empty list. If the keyword is empty or null, it will return an empty list.
